domain.title: Domain
domain.description: HA domain filter (e.g., 'zone', 'person', 'input_boolean'). None = all entities.

type.title: Type
type.description: Bead type, e.g. 'expense', 'bill', 'budget', 'digest'. Omit for all types.

parent_id.title: Parent Id
parent_id.description: Restrict to children of this bead id.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: The EA object type to compute the impact of

category.title: Category
category.description: Pick the closest match. Coffee/restaurants → 'dining'. Supermarket → 'groceries'.

bead_id.title: Bead Id
bead_id.description: UUID returned when the bill was logged.

parent_id.title: Parent Id
parent_id.description: dev.task bead id this note is filed against

NoteCreateRequest.title: NoteCreateRequest
NoteCreateRequest.description:
The closed dev.note shape -- mirrors
apps/substrate/src/schemas.py::DevNoteContent's own implied shape, so
this route refuses exactly what the store would refuse (this bead's
AC-3), not a second intake that accepts more and just moves the 422 one
layer out.

field.title: Field
field.description: Transaction content field to match (e.g. 'normalized_merchant'; 'vendor' aliases to it).

value.title: Value
value.description: Value/pattern to match against the field (case-insensitive).

target_category.title: Target Category
target_category.description: Category to assign to matching, currently-Uncategorized transactions.

scenario_name.title: Scenario Name
scenario_name.description: Label for this what-if, e.g. 'Buy New Car'.

monthly_impact.title: Monthly Impact
monthly_impact.description: Recurring monthly cash-flow change. Negative for a new cost (e.g. -600 car payment), positive for new income.

upfront_impact.title: Upfront Impact
upfront_impact.description: One-time cash impact applied at month 0. Negative for an outlay (e.g. -5000 down payment).
